license.privacy.offline_text: All document parsing, text extraction, OCR, and visual pixel overlay diffing run completely offline on your local machine. No document or text data is ever sent across the network.
license.privacy.telemetry_text: DiffAnyDoc contains no tracking scripts, analytics, or document telemetry. Your contracts, invoices, and source code stay 100% private and confidential.
license.privacy.updates_text: Update checks run only when you explicitly press Check now in the Updates dialog. The request only contacts public GitHub Releases and transmits no device or document identifiers.
license.terms.disclaimer_text: The Software is provided "AS IS", without warranty of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the author shall not be liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from use of the software.

license.terms.restrictions_text: You may not reverse engineer, decompile, resell, sublicense, or bundle DiffAnyDoc into a competing product or hosted SaaS without explicit written permission.

help.annotate.draw: Turn on Mark on page, then drag a box on a page and type a note. Use it for changes the tool did not find.
help.annotate.remove: Click × on a mark to remove it. The bin button removes all marks.
help.merge.all: The Copy menu applies all changes in one direction (A → B or B → A) and downloads the merged document.
help.merge.line: Each changed line has an arrow next to its number. → copies the left line to the right side, ← copies the right line to the left side.
help.modes.pages: Pages: the rendered pages with boxes on the changed text. Pick the box color with the color button.
help.modes.text: Text: both documents side by side, line by line. Only the changed words are highlighted.
help.modes.xray: X-Ray: both pages laid on top of each other. Removed ink is red, added ink is green.
help.modes.zoom: In Pages and X-Ray, zoom with the zoom buttons or Ctrl + mouse wheel. Hold Space and drag, or drag with the middle mouse button, to move a zoomed page.
help.start.drop: Drop two files on the window, or click A and B to choose them. Two files dropped at once fill both sides.
help.start.ocr: Scanned pages and images are read with built-in OCR. Nothing leaves your machine.
help.start.preload: Reading starts as soon as you pick the first file, so the comparison is ready faster. Identical files are detected at once by checksum.
